name: gemini_get_doc
description: Retrieve the full content of a documentation page by its chunk_id (returned by search_docs). Each chunk is self-contained — do NOT set context on your first read. Only use context=1..3 if, after reading, you find the chunk references adjacent sections you need.

chunk_id.description: The exact ID of the chunk to retrieve, as returned by search_docs (e.g., 'guides/retries.md#backoff-strategy').

context.description: Number of adjacent chunks to include before and after the target chunk. Default 0 (recommended). Chunks are self-contained; only increase after an initial read if you need broader page context.
